In particular, the service contract will address the specific needs linked to:— the provision of scientific and technical advice on an ad-hoc basis on issues linked directly or indirectly to the nitrates directive,— the production of reports concerning scientific and technical issues related to nutrients use and management, including analysis of the Member States' action programmes under the nitrates directive— the analysis of reports submitted to the commission by Member States within a context of a derogation granted in accordance with annex III 2.(b) of the nitrates directive, focusing on the issue of the possible impact on water quality of such derogations.
